rawBlockNode.name: story-copy
rawBlockNode.content: With almost one century of experience and a research and development department that continuously studies and works on new technologies, PAMA develops and manufactures boring machines, milling machines and machining centres for various sectors for which it guarantees quality and reliability.

rawBlockNode.name: story-card-1-body
rawBlockNode.content: Processing of hard materials for titanium, Inconel and steel alloys in aerospace applications.

rawBlockNode.name: story-card-2-body
rawBlockNode.content: High precision and repeatability for thermal, nuclear and renewable energy production.

rawBlockNode.name: story-card-3-body
rawBlockNode.content: Flexible machining solutions designed for demanding transport components.

rawBlockNode.name: about-title
rawBlockNode.content: One Italian story, over 90 years of machine-tool expertise.

rawBlockNode.name: about-copy
rawBlockNode.content: PAMA is an Italian company that has been present in the machine tool market for over 90 years, known for building large and medium-large units, well appreciated in all sectors where maximum rigidity and high precision are required.

rawBlockNode.name: products-copy
rawBlockNode.content: PAMA’s machine tools provide optimal precision and precisely perform boring, drilling, milling and turning operations, satisfying customer requirements in the most demanding industries.

rawBlockNode.name: product-card-1-body
rawBlockNode.content: Portal and T-type structures designed for maximum versatility and high precision.

rawBlockNode.name: product-card-2-body
rawBlockNode.content: Central headstock milling machines built for dynamics, reliability and precision.

rawBlockNode.name: product-card-3-body
rawBlockNode.content: High metal-removal boring and milling machines for demanding industrial work.

rawBlockNode.content: PAMA is proud of its many years of experience in the field of machine tools and provides its customers with a wide range of services and contracts to ensure the sustained highest level of performance of its products.
